source_document.body:
2026 Paris Motor Show • Project KO11 Is Proof That Geely Wants To "Knock Out" Range Rover, Launches Next Year in Europe
Jaguar Hints at SUV Model, So Imagination Land Immediately Comes Up With the Type 02 Crossover
11 photos
Photo: n_the_detailz / Instagram
The British automaker JLR didn’t wait for the 2026 Paris Motor Show and presented the Jaguar Type 01 grand tourer sedan earlier in October, aiming to make an impression and steal the catwalk’s spotlight instead of getting involved with all the other brands at the Mondial de l’Auto.
So, instead of the French capital, Jaguar chose to hold the world premiere of its new all-electric grand tourer in New York City, despite America’s current adversity to EVs. Despite the Paris Motor Show having over 60 automakers and a ton of new concepts, traditional names like Jaguar or Audi are notable absentees.
Anyway, Jag’s most powerful road car in history, the Type 01 , arrived with Type 00 Concept-inspired styling, adapting the dramatic cues to a fastback sedan body type and featuring a high-performance electric powertrain and a sophisticated chassis setup. The figures are quite revealing: 1,016 horsepower and 1,007 pound-feet of torque for the combined output, zero to 62 mph in 3.2 seconds, a perfect 50:50 weight distribution, and a new 850-volt architecture packing an 118-kWh battery pack for a range of up to 450 miles according to WLTP.
The impressive new model is 206.4 inches long and only 55.24 inches tall, so there will be voices claiming that it doesn’t matter that it has a fancy Dynamic Air suspension, active aerodynamics, or thin 3.31-inch HD LED projector headlights or massive 23-inch wheels if they don’t fit within because of the low height, which is akin to something like a Ford Mustang. No worries, though, as Jaguar has a solution.
More precisely, Jaguar’s four-door GT that helped relaunch the brand won’t be alone for long, as executives talked to the rumor mill and hinted that their next vehicle will arrive soon, without going into specifics. It will surely use the Type 01’s bold new styling direction when it arrives, and there are hints regarding a possible crossover.
Naturally, the members of the imaginative guild of digital car content creators dwelling across the parallel universes of vehicular CGI have quickly embraced the rumor and came up with an interpretation. For example, the automotive enthusiasts behind 'n_the_detailz' on social media have imagined the Jaguar Type 02 crossover SUV just as Jaguar hints at the possibility.
The unofficial, hypothetical design project is basically a taller and shorter version of the four-door GT, and to make it possible to stand out in any crowd, it comes with a wacky idea. No, we’re not talking about the regular rear window or the classic driver setup with a digital cluster behind the steering wheel (with physical buttons) and a large central display.
Instead, the wacky stuff revolves around the rear doors, which appear to be hinged in the middle in order to allow for both a conventional opening as well as acting like coach doors. What do you think – yay or nay? View this post on Instagram A post shared by n_the_detailz car collective (@n_the_detailz)
